questions.prompt: Write the correct form of the verb in brackets.
questions.explanation: After 'No sooner' use the past perfect with inversion: had he arrived.

wrongReasons.he had arrived: After 'No sooner' the auxiliary must come before the subject.
wrongReasons.did he arrive: 'No sooner' is followed by the past perfect: had he arrived.

questions.text: No sooner ___ (he / arrive) than it began to rain.

questions.prompt: Write the correct form of the verb in brackets.
questions.explanation: After 'I'd rather' + a new subject, use the past simple: I'd rather you didn't tell.

wrongReasons.don't tell: After 'I'd rather' + subject, use the past simple.
wrongReasons.wouldn't tell: 'would' is not used after 'I'd rather' + subject.
